title: Estimate vessel activity by gridding detections and normalizing by SAR overpasses (rolling 24-day window)
description: Convert individual detections to average vessel activity by aggregating detections on a spatial grid at 1/200° (~550 m) resolution and normalizing each pixel by the number of satellite overpasses. Build a daily time series using a rolling 24-day window (two Sentinel-1 repeat cycles): aggregate detections within the window and assign to the center date. Restrict temporal analysis to pixels with at least 70 of 77 possible 24-day periods. For pixels with no overpass for 24 days, linearly interpolate the time series at that location.

inputs.detections: Filtered vessel detections (optionally by category: AIS-matched vs not)

outputs.activity_grid: Normalized activity grid per day (average vessels present)
outputs.activity_timeseries: Daily time series per pixel or aggregated region
